affinity.title: affinity
affinity.description: Node/pod affinity and anti-affinity rules used to constrain pod scheduling.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for the deployment.

maxReplicas.title: maxReplicas
maxReplicas.description: The maximum number of replicas the HorizontalPodAutoscaler will scale up to.

minReplicas.title: minReplicas
minReplicas.description: The minimum number of replicas the HorizontalPodAutoscaler will scale down to.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.title: targetCPUUtilizationPercentage
targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: The average CPU utilization percentage the HorizontalPodAutoscaler targets when deciding to scale.

autoscaling.title: autoscaling
autoscaling.description: This section is for setting up autoscaling more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/autoscaling/

host.title: host
host.description: Hostname of the database server. Not used when type is sqlite.

migration.title: migration
migration.description: Whether to automatically run database schema migrations on startup.

name.title: name
name.description: Name of the database to connect to (or the sqlite database file name).

password.title: password
password.description: The DT_DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable should be used instead of this field.

port.title: port
port.description: Port of the database server. Not used when type is sqlite.

type.title: type
type.description:
Which database backend Donetick connects to.

When set to `sqlite`, the host/port/user/password fields below are ignored.

user.title: user
user.description: Username used to authenticate with the database. Not used when type is sqlite.

appHost.title: appHost
appHost.description: The public base URL of this Donetick instance, used to build links included in outgoing emails.

email.title: email
email.description: The "from" email address used when sending emails.

host.title: host
host.description: Hostname of the SMTP server used to send emails. Leave empty to disable email sending.

key.title: key
key.description: The DT_EMAIL_KEY environment variable should be used instead of this field.

port.title: port
port.description: Port of the SMTP server used to send emails.

email.title: email
email.description: SMTP settings used to send transactional emails (e.g. password resets, notifications).

is_done_tick_dot_com.title: is_done_tick_dot_com
is_done_tick_dot_com.description: Marks this instance as the official donetick.com hosted service. Should remain false for self-hosted deployments.

is_user_creation_disabled.title: is_user_creation_disabled
is_user_creation_disabled.description: When true, disables the ability for new users to sign up/register accounts.

max_refresh.title: max_refresh
max_refresh.description:
The maximum amount of time a session can be refreshed/extended before the user must re-authenticate.

Expressed as a Go duration string (e.g. `168h`).

secret.title: secret
secret.description: The DT_JWT_SECRET environment variable should be used instead of this field.

session_time.title: session_time
session_time.description:
How long an issued session token remains valid before requiring the user to log in again.

Expressed as a Go duration string (e.g. `168h`).

jwt.title: jwt
jwt.description: JSON Web Token settings used for authenticating API/session requests.

development.title: development
development.description: Enables development-friendly logging (more verbose, human-readable output).

level.title: level
level.description: The minimum log level that will be emitted.

name.title: name
name.description: The display name of this Donetick instance, and also the filename used for the rendered config (config.name.yaml).

auth_url.title: auth_url
auth_url.description: The identity provider's authorization endpoint URL.

client_id.title: client_id
client_id.description: The OAuth2 client ID issued by the identity provider.

client_secret.title: client_secret
client_secret.description: The DT_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable should be used instead of this field.

name.title: name
name.description: Display name for the OAuth2 provider, shown on the login button in the UI.

redirect_url.title: redirect_url
redirect_url.description: The URL the identity provider redirects back to after authentication, must match the provider's app configuration.

token_url.title: token_url
token_url.description: The identity provider's token exchange endpoint URL.

user_info_url.title: user_info_url
user_info_url.description: The identity provider's user info endpoint URL, used to fetch profile details after authentication.

oauth2.title: oauth2
oauth2.description: OAuth2/OIDC settings for enabling third-party single sign-on.

token.title: token
token.description:
The Pushover application API token used to send notifications.

The DT_PUSHOVER_TOKEN environment variable should be used instead of this field.

pushover.title: pushover
pushover.description: Pushover integration used for sending notifications.

allowed_origins.title: allowed_origins
allowed_origins.description:
List of origins allowed to open real-time (WebSocket/SSE) connections.

`"*"` allows any origin.

cleanup_interval.title: cleanup_interval
cleanup_interval.description: How often the server scans for and removes stale/dead real-time connections, expressed as a Go duration string.

connection_timeout.title: connection_timeout
connection_timeout.description: How long a real-time connection may remain idle before being closed, expressed as a Go duration string.

enable_compression.title: enable_compression
enable_compression.description: Enables compression of real-time messages sent to clients.

enable_stats.title: enable_stats
enable_stats.description: Enables collection of real-time connection statistics/metrics.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Enables the real-time update feature (WebSocket/SSE push updates to connected clients).

event_queue_size.title: event_queue_size
event_queue_size.description: Size of the internal queue used to buffer outgoing real-time events before they are delivered to clients.

heartbeat_interval.title: heartbeat_interval
heartbeat_interval.description: How often the server sends a heartbeat/ping to connected real-time clients, expressed as a Go duration string.

max_connections.title: max_connections
max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent real-time connections allowed across all users.

max_connections_per_user.title: max_connections_per_user
max_connections_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent real-time connections allowed per individual user.

sse_enabled.title: sse_enabled
sse_enabled.description: Enables Server-Sent Events (SSE) as a transport for real-time updates, in addition to WebSockets.

stale_threshold.title: stale_threshold
stale_threshold.description: How long a real-time connection may go without activity before being considered stale, expressed as a Go duration string.

due_job.title: due_job
due_job.description: How often the job that checks for tasks that just became due runs.

overdue_job.title: overdue_job
overdue_job.description: How often the job that checks for overdue tasks runs.

pre_due_job.title: pre_due_job
pre_due_job.description: How often the job that checks for tasks that are about to become due runs.

scheduler_jobs.title: scheduler_jobs
scheduler_jobs.description: Intervals at which the background jobs that scan for due/overdue tasks run. Expressed as Go duration strings.

cors_allow_origins.title: cors_allow_origins
cors_allow_origins.description: List of origins allowed to make cross-origin (CORS) requests to the API.

port.title: port
port.description: The TCP port the Donetick HTTP server listens on inside the container.

rate_limit.title: rate_limit
rate_limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per client within server.rate_period.

rate_period.title: rate_period
rate_period.description: The time window over which server.rate_limit is enforced, expressed as a Go duration string.

read_timeout.title: read_timeout
read_timeout.description: Maximum duration for reading the entire request, expressed as a Go duration string.

serve_frontend.title: serve_frontend
serve_frontend.description: Whether the server also serves the built frontend web assets, in addition to the API.

write_timeout.title: write_timeout
write_timeout.description: Maximum duration before timing out writes of the response, expressed as a Go duration string.

token.title: token
token.description:
The Telegram bot API token used to send notifications.

The DT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN environment variable should be used instead of this field.

telegram.title: telegram
telegram.description: Telegram bot integration used for sending notifications.

env.title: env
examples:
- name: DT_JWT_SECRET
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: donetick-jwt-secret
      key: jwt-secret
- name: DT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: donetick-telegram-token
      key: token
- name: DT_PUSHOVER_TOKEN
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: donetick-pushover-token
      key: token
- name: DT_DATABASE_PASSWORD
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: donetick-database-password
      key: password
- name: DT_EMAIL_KEY
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: donetick-email-key
      key: key
- name: DT_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: donetick-oauth2-client-secret
      key: secret

fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride
fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the fully qualified name of the release used to generate resource names.

parentRefs.title: parentRefs
parentRefs.description: Which Gateways this Route is attached to.

rules.title: rules
rules.description: List of rules and filters applied.
examples:
filters:
  - type: RequestHeaderModifier
    requestHeaderModifier:
      set:
      - name: My-Overwrite-Header
        value: this-is-the-only-value
      remove:
      - User-Agent
- matches:
  - path:
      type: PathPrefix
      value: /echo
    headers:
    - name: version
      value: v2

httpRoute.title: httpRoute
httpRoute.description:
Expose the service via gateway-api HTTPRoute
Requires Gateway API resources and suitable controller installed within the cluster
(see https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/guides/)

pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy
pullPolicy.description: This sets the pull policy for images.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: The container image repository to pull the donetick image from.

tag.title: tag
tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

image.title: image
image.description: This sets the container image more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/

imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets
imagePullSecrets.description: This is for the secrets for pulling an image from a private repository more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/pull-image-private-registry/

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress resource.

className.title: className
className.description: The name of the IngressClass to use for the Ingress resource.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource for the application.

hosts.title: hosts
hosts.description: List of hostnames and path rules to route to the application.

tls.title: tls
tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress resource.

ingress.title: ingress
ingress.description: This block is for setting up the ingress for more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/

nameOverride.title: nameOverride
nameOverride.description: This is to override the chart name.

nodeSelector.title: nodeSelector
nodeSelector.description: Node labels for pod assignment, used to constrain which nodes the pod can be scheduled on.

podAnnotations.title: podAnnotations
podAnnotations.description: This is for setting Kubernetes Annotations to a Pod. For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/

podLabels.title: podLabels
podLabels.description: This is for setting Kubernetes Labels to a Pod. For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext
podSecurityContext.description: Security context settings applied at the pod level.

replicaCount.title: replicaCount
replicaCount.description: This will set the replicaset count more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/replicaset/

resources.title: resources
resources.description:
We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
examples:
limits:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi
requests:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi

securityContext.title: securityContext
examples:
capabilities:
  drop:
  - ALL
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
runAsNonRoot: true
runAsUser: 1000

port.title: port
port.description: This sets the ports more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#field-spec-ports

type.title: type
type.description: This sets the service type more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#publishing-services-service-types

service.title: service
service.description: This is for setting up a service more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

automount.title: automount
automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials?

name.title: name
name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

serviceAccount.title: serviceAccount
serviceAccount.description: This section builds out the service account more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/

tolerations.title: tolerations
tolerations.description: A list of tolerations that allow the pod to be scheduled onto nodes with matching taints.
